dedupe_keys.name: meteorological observations in tall masts for the coastal highway e39 project in mid norway

description: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute and Norwegian Public Roads Administration publish wind observations from tall masts supporting the Coastal Highway E39 bridge project in western Norway. Masts of 50–100 m measure three-dimensional wind at two to four heights in complex terrain around Halsafjorden, Julsundet and Storfjorden. The collection contains filtered 10-Hz observations and 10-minute means, with temperature profiles and additional meteorological variables at selected sites. Measurements begin in February 2014, and the current THREDDS catalogue lists years through 2024. Download and OPeNDAP access are free under CC-BY-4.0. These site observations can calibrate local wind-flow simulations and assess wind exposure for long bridges. The collection complements coarser meteorological reanalyses. Coverage varies by mast, height and variable. The catalogue listing does not establish completeness within each year, and the provider’s earlier statement that monitoring would continue until at least 2024 is a plan, not confirmation of later observations. No measurement files were inspected.
